in te zullen schuiven

glosses: To put in between or into.

examples.text: In order to withdraw money from a cash machine, you have to insert your debit card.
To make your proof easier to understand, I recommend you insert a few more steps.

glosses: A promotional or instructive leaflet inserted into a magazine, newspaper, tape or disk package, etc.

examples.text: This software can print compact disc inserts if you have the right size of paper.

glosses: A mechanical component inserted into another.
An expression, such as \"please\" or an interjection, that may occur at various points in an utterance.
A sequence of DNA inserted into another DNA molecule.
A pre-recorded segment included as part of a live broadcast.
A close-up shot used to draw attention to a particular element of a larger scene.

examples.text: […] close-ups of her legs on the escalator, an insert of the emergency stop button (ARRET D'URGENCE), intercut close-ups of her glance and the cinema sign, […]

glosses: A plug-in that adds an effect to an audio track.
A key to toggle between text insert mode and overwrite mode
